claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.ProcessCritical (0x06004ECA) is an instance method with one SkillData parameter named sd and an exact 277-byte body. It first tests raw sd.flags mask 40; when that mask is zero it stores isKO=1 and KO_Return=320. It then always calls SetLastDamage(65535.0f) and stores KoLastDamage=65535.0f. For each nonzero sd attack-power field it applies the exact corresponding zeroing action: atkPow_HP calls SetHP(0.0f), atkPow_SP calls SetSP(0.0f), atkPow_Neck/Arm/Waist/Leg store 0.0f into the matching Player limb field, and atkPow_BP calls SetBP(0.0f). Raw sd.flags mask 64 stores isWannaGiveUp=1. Finally raw sd.flags mask 8 selects PlayMatchSE(30,1.0f,PlIdx); the alternate path loads MatchUI.inst and calls Show_Critical(1), then returns. FACT-0020 pins the exact caller boundary on the CriticalCheck-true branch: ApplyDamage IL+0x01D2 invokes defender.ProcessCritical(CurrentSkill) and then joins the shared tail at IL+0x04EA.
